response.rationale: Biopsy confirms smooth muscle origin; low Ki-67 (2%) and positive ER/PR favor benign leiomyoma over leiomyosarcoma. CD34 positivity alone is insufficient for solitary fibrous tumor given negative CD117/S-100/Dog-1.

rejected.why: Ki-67 2% is very low for leiomyosarcoma; no malignant features described.
CD34 positivity is nonspecific; lacks supporting markers and contradicts negative CD117/S-100/Dog-1.
